description_en: This Śiva temple is located at Ṭeku Dobhāna, the confluence of the rivers Vāgamati and Viṣṇumati. There is no evidence to date its initial construction, however, the architectural features suggest that it was built during the second half of the 19th century. The temple was severely damaged during the 2015 CE earthquakes and was near collapse. In 2020 CE (VS 2077), the Government of Nepal and the Asian Development Bank invested twentylakhrupees in its reconstruction. Theśivalingain the sanctum was stolen before 2015. Following the temple's reconstructionin 2020 CE a newliṅgawas installed.As of January 2022, no social or religious events take place at the temple. At one point, the temple premises turned into a gathering place for drug addicts.
description_ne: टेकु दोभानमा रहेको यो शिव मन्दिर कसले र कहिले बनाएको थियो भन्ने स्पष्ट पार्ने कुनै ऐतिहासिक सामग्री भेटिएको छैन । मन्दिरको शैली हेर्दा यो राणाकालमा निर्माण गरिएको होला भन्ने अनुमान गर्न सकिन्छ । मन्दिरमा हेचाचाह गर्ने कोही नहुनाले मन्दिरभित्रको शिवलिङ्ग पनि चोरी भएको थियो । यो मन्दिर लागुपदार्थ दुर्व्यसनीहरू भेला हुने ठाउँ बनिसकेको थियो । विसं २०७२ (सन् २१०१५) को भूकम्पले मन्दिर चर्केर ढल्ने अवस्थामा पुगेको थियो । नेपाल सरकार र एशियन बिकास बैंकले मिलेर रु. बीस लाख खर्च विसं २०७७ श्रावण ५ गते (सन् २०२०) मा मन्दिरको पुनर्निर्माण कार्य सम्पन्न गरिएको थियो । यस मन्दिरमा कुनै धार्मिक, सांस्कृतिक गतिविधि हुँदैन ।

historical_events.event_description: The temple was severely damaged during the 2015 CE earthquakes.
The Government of Nepal and the Asian Development Bank jointly reconstructed the temple at a cost of two million rupees. After the reconstruction, a newśivaliṅgawas consecrated inside the sanctum.
